title: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation
question: For each department, what is the department name and the standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the areas of its rooms, considering only departments that have more than 5 rooms, are associated with a non-null DLC key, and are not the 'ADMISSIONS' department or the 'Political Science' department? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
  STDDEV(r.AREA)
FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o
  ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
WHERE o.DLC_KEY IS NOT NULL
  AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME NOT IN ('ADMISSIONS', 'Political Science')
GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
HAVING COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) > 5
